'''Djinn Kylo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Force Adept]] who lived on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]].

==History==
As a young boy, Kylo could see and sense things that others couldn't. He could [[Precognition/Legends|see into the future]] and [[Force empathy/Legends|sense other people's emotions]]. When he was sixteen, he was brought to the elders of his people and surprised them by quickly learning all their skills. He was hailed as being very gifted and was sent out into [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] on a quest to find [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] so that he could learn more and hone his abilities. He was given the [[Dakshee Holocron]] to aid him in his quest.<ref name="Game" />
